programme.title: GREAT TIMES

programme.title: BATTLE OF MARRIAGE
programme.desc: Lok Ching menghilangkan diri dan tidak kembali untuk penggambaran. Namun dia muncul semula setelah dipujuk Chek Kap, tetapi bertegas untuk berbaik semula dengan Chung Yiu. Anak perempuan Chung Yiu, iaitu Teng Yao, dilaporkan hilang.

programme.title: THE PROMISE
programme.desc: Zhang Shao Ting bersembahyang di rumah moyang yang terbiar atas permintaan datuknya. Dia terkena kejutan elektrik semasa mengecas telefon bimbit. Tiba-tiba, nenek moyangnya, Wen An muncul.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Sedih kerana Yi Lin enggan menerima kenyataan tentang dirinya sebagai pembunuh upahan, You De memabukkan diri. Atas dorongan Qing Tian, dia berusaha memujuk Yi Lin dan menjelaskan sebab terpaksa berbuat demikian demi membesarkannya.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Dengan hati berat, Ivan meninggalkan Chang Sheng selepas gagal mencapai persefahaman. Dia sempat berpesan kepada Qian Ying dan Qian Shou agar menjaga Chang Sheng serta memaklumkannya jika memerlukan pertolongan.

programme.title: THE FADING GOLD
programme.desc: Tiga beradik Fang berdamai dan sepakat menggugurkan tuntutan mahkamah terhadap bapa mereka, walaupun konflik dengan Lin Cheng berterusan. Sementara itu, Yangtian dan Gao Shen ke Bandar Pengyang untuk menyiasat kemalangan kereta.

programme.title: THE COMPANY
programme.desc: Usaha Bei Lu untuk menghalang ibu bapanya daripada pergi ke Ninghai sia-sia. Akhirnya kedua-duanya terbunuh dalam satu kemalangan kereta yang membawa maut. Bi Zi memberitahu Bei Lu bahawa takdir tidak boleh dilawan.

programme.title: MY STAR FAMILY

programme.title: WONDERLAND OF LOVE
programme.desc: Li Ni cuba berhadapan dengan Li Jun atas kematian pengasuhnya tapi dihalang jeneral Pei Yuan. Maharaja pula memihak kepada Li Jun. Namun, dua orang menteri veteran memberi tekanan dan akhirnya Li Jun di tempatkan dalam buangan.

programme.title: THE PROMISE

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: "When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes. In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life."

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He travels to Shannan, the cradle of Tibetan culture. Nestled in the gentlest valley of the Yarlung Zangbo River, this is where the first Tibetan king rose to power, the first palace in Xizang was built, and many other “firsts” in Xizang’s history began. Tianran visits Yamdrok Lake, one of Xizang’s three sacred lakes, where a paragliding base is taking shape. He then learns the art of Tibetan opera, joins rangers on a mission to track the elusive Tibetan red deer, and ends the day with a rejuvenating soak in a village revitalized by hot spring tourism.

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: "When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes. In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life."

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He travels to Shannan, the cradle of Tibetan culture. Nestled in the gentlest valley of the Yarlung Zangbo River, this is where the first Tibetan king rose to power, the first palace in Xizang was built, and many other “firsts” in Xizang’s history began. Tianran visits Yamdrok Lake, one of Xizang’s three sacred lakes, where a paragliding base is taking shape. He then learns the art of Tibetan opera, joins rangers on a mission to track the elusive Tibetan red deer, and ends the day with a rejuvenating soak in a village revitalized by hot spring tourism.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-5 Xingyi Quan
programme.desc: In Episode 5, Kleber travels to Shanxi, the birthplace of Xingyi Quan. He follows Master Cao Bing, a traditional Xingyi Quan teacher and modern combat coach, from Taiyuan’s noodle shops to Pingyao’s ancient streets, and from centuries-old vinegar breweries to Guandi temples, exploring Xingyi Quan’s deep links to Shanxi’s merchant culture and history. Master Cao breaks down the core principles of the “Five Elements and Twelve Forms”, and shows in his modern gym how techniques found in Muay Thai and Jiu-Jitsu can be integrated without losing Xingyi Quan’s philosophical core, guided by the mindset of taking only what is essential. Set against ancient sites such as Yongle Palace, this episode shows how true inner strength is like traditional timber architecture: stable, balanced, and built from within.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-6 Shandong Mantis Style
programme.desc: The final episode traces the cross-ocean transmission of Shandong Mantis Style. In the mountains of northern Italy, host Kleber visits Dante Basili, a veteran Italian practitioner in his sixties, who recounts travelling to China 36 years ago to learn Mantis Style and returning home to teach Chinese martial arts ever since. Kleber then heads to Shandong to meet Yu Bo and Yu Tao, sons of Mantis Style grandmaster Yu Hai. He witnesses a traditional apprenticeship ceremony and explores the style’s fighting essence: adopting its spirit rather than merely copying its form. The episode shows how Mantis Style has taken root and flourished in different cultural settings. Ultimately, this journey across Europe and Asia suggests that transmission is not only about techniques, but also about dialogue across time and distance, and a shared resonance of spirit between cultures.

programme.title: Born to climb

To further fuel his passion, Bobby's father refurnished a room at home and turned it into a private rock-climbing gym. While many students find themselves "climbing the walls" with frustration on weeknights and grumbling at their homework, Bobby spends most of his free time clambering around the surfaces of his bedroom as he aspires to become a celebrated outdoor rock climber one day.

programme.title: Born to climb
programme.desc: Bobby, aka Lin Ziguan, is a passionate young climber in Wenzhou City, east China's Zhejiang Province. He first came across the sport when his parents took him to an indoor climbing facility at a local shopping mall for fun, and it was a case of love at first sight. To further fuel his passion, Bobby's father refurnished a room at home and turned it into a private rock-climbing gym. While many students find themselves "climbing the walls" with frustration on weeknights and grumbling at their homework, Bobby spends most of his free time clambering around the surfaces of his bedroom as he aspires to become a celebrated outdoor rock climber one day.

programme.title: Ad Break

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-6 Shandong Mantis Style
programme.desc: The final episode traces the cross-ocean transmission of Shandong Mantis Style. In the mountains of northern Italy, host Kleber visits Dante Basili, a veteran Italian practitioner in his sixties, who recounts travelling to China 36 years ago to learn Mantis Style and returning home to teach Chinese martial arts ever since. Kleber then heads to Shandong to meet Yu Bo and Yu Tao, sons of Mantis Style grandmaster Yu Hai. He witnesses a traditional apprenticeship ceremony and explores the style’s fighting essence: adopting its spirit rather than merely copying its form. The episode shows how Mantis Style has taken root and flourished in different cultural settings. Ultimately, this journey across Europe and Asia suggests that transmission is not only about techniques, but also about dialogue across time and distance, and a shared resonance of spirit between cultures.

programme.title: BEAUTIFUL WORLD
programme.desc: HUSBAND. Di dunia dominasi wanita, tuduhan curang membawa padah tragis buat seorang doktor. Pada masa sama, pegawai polis Shu Xian berdepan tekanan keluarga apabila isterinya disuruh berkahwin lain akibat masalah zuriat.

programme.title: MELASTIK KE HATIMU 2
programme.desc: Fatin tekad dan simpan dendam setelah apa yang Haura buat pada dia. Selepas pemeriksaan doktor, Haura tak mahu beritahu Ziyyad jantina baby mereka, dia mahu buat kejutan. Ziyyad dan Haura mahu beli baju baby.

programme.title: SANTAU PEREMPUAN TERLARANG

programme.title: IN
programme.desc: A passionate and hardworking journalist tracks a string of killings that shake her city. She tries to solve the crime, unaware that the murderer might be extremely close to home.

programme.title: Ratchagan
programme.desc: A man with anger issues falls in love with a woman but later, the lady's father demands him to manage his rage within three months in order to marry his daughter.

programme.title: Dasavatharam

programme.title: Vamanapuram Bus Route

programme.desc: Saandrithazh

programme.title: I'M LIVE - ADOY
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the city pop band ADOY! Composed of vocalist and guitarist Oh Juhwan keyboardist Zee bassist Jung Dayoung and drummer Park Geunchang this quartet burst onto the music scene in 2017 with the EP CATNIP. Thanks to the success of Grace and San Francisco from the EP they topped the K-Indie Chart and became nominated for Best Modern Rock at the prestigious Korean Music Awards in 2018. Then in the following year they won Judges' Prize at the Seoul Music Awards creating a new flow of Korean city pop. ADOY's music has a special power. Iit fills the city with romantic vibes instantly and also transforms city noises into sophisticated tunes. What's more their music has mass appeal yet it is unique. So now the quartet itself is a genre that mesmerizes not only Korean listeners but also the world. Last month ADOY released their new EP her to display their ever-evolving artistry and the quartet is here to perform their latest tracks including Simply Antihero Baby and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet ADOY!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - FROM ALL TO HUMAN
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the R&B quintet FROM ALL TO HUMAN! Composed of vocalist Blesssing guitarist PARK JAE WOO bassist NAM WOO SEOK keyboardist MOON SUNG HWAN and drummer MOON SEONG HO this band brought a new wave of R&B to the Korean music scene upon their debut in 2017. With their band's name referring to a journey “from all beings to humans” the five hope to develop every day as musicians. True to their name they are evolving and developing every day winning the Grand Prize at the 2019 Shinhan Card Rookie Project and the TOP2 at KT&G’s SangSang Madang Band Discovery Competition in 2019. From acid jazz to R&B to new jack swing the quintet covers a wide range of genres in their music backed up by solid storylines which makes them truly one of a kind. In this episode FROM ALL TO HUMAN performs Dizzy Oriental chill Don't be disappointed and more to showcase the quintessence of their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these five genuine musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Kim Jae-hyung
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Kim Jae-hyung! Kim Jae-hyung is a self-taught guitarist who picked up the guitar when he was serving in the NAVY as a secretary for the naval military band. He continued playing the instrument after his discharge and had the first public performance in 2013 at an unplugged open mic night. Then in 2017 he released his first EP CIRCUS. Three years later he presented his first full-length album Flex which was nominated for Best Folk Album at the 2021 Korean Music Awards and the lead single Failure Story was nominated for Best Folk Song. Kim Jae-hyung is also known for covering a wide spectrum of music. Recently he came up with a new single titled Addiction with danceable vibes. Constantly pushing his musical boundaries this artist definitely makes us look forward to his future moves. In this episode Kim Jae-hyung performs Addiction Failure Story More Doubt and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - J_ust
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a singer who just wants to present good music - J_ust! J_ust made his debut in 2015 with the mini-album #DearMuse #201507_08 #PinkRibbon. Known for his heartfelt lyrics and sounds he comforts numerous listeners at the end of a tough day. Thanks to that magical power Jeong Eun-ji from Apink released a remake of his song How's your night for the soundtrack of She's My Type and his song Way Back Home was featured in the ending of JTBC Newsroom. In this episode J_ust performs How's your night Way Back Home I wanna go out Actually I like you and will be happy to console everyone's heart. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy all the heartwarming songs he has to comfort you!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - YESEO
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is electronic musician and producer YESEO! This artist burst into the music scene in 2016 with her first single Let It All Go. Two years later in 2018 she was nominated for Best Rookie Best Dance & Electronic Album Best Dance & Electronic Song at the 15th Korean Music Awards with her first EP Million Things. This talented musician mesmerized not only domestic listeners but those outside Korea. The UK's Noisey highlighted YESEO as one of the most ambitious young guns in Seoul and she even opened for Cherokee and Honne during their concerts in Seoul. In this episode YESEO performs Privacy HOT HAND Cigarette Light as well as Youthful Kids and Free Up from her latest EP TRY TREE! Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - YEGNY
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter YEGNY formerly known as Choi Ye-geun! This artist first became known in 2012 as the genius keyboardist in an audition program titled K-pop Star - Season 2. Since then she has actively pursued her career as a musician releasing a number of singles and working with other top-notch musicians including AKMU. Last year YEGNY released her first full-length album Even If Get Lost It Can Flow Anyway and shared with the public her concerns as a musician and self-reflection as well as her view on human relationships and social issues. With the song Better Rush (feat. Huckleberry P) she changed her stage name to YEGNY to mark a new beginning as an artist. In this episode YEGNY performs Better Rush I know Lucid dream and Unbalance as well as her cover of Better by BoA and Irony by Wonder Girls. Tune in to I'm LIVE and check out all that YEGNY has to show off!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - ARO
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter ARO! ARO burst into the music scene in July 2018 with the single A Good Daughter. Her stage name means engraving in Korean which conveys her hope to engrave her name in the minds of the public. She's also known for her ability to express common relatable issues in her own unique way deeply touching and soothing listeners' hearts. Sentimental at times yet unpredictable at others she's definitely engraving her name in our hearts. In this episode ARO performs SEESAW When The Night Comes Day 1 Why Did You Answer? and also her cover of Delispice's Confession. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - PARKMOONCHI
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the hottest newtro master PARKMOONCHI! PARKMOONCHI became known to the public through the variety show Hangout with Yoo where she displayed her exceptional ability to put her own contemporary spin to 1990s music. That sensational appearance led her to actively collaborate with numerous big names in the music scene including Suho and Baekhyun from EXO Kang Daniel Kwon Jin Ah and Young K from Day6. Also known for her witty and unexpectional point of view PARKMOONCHI shares with everyone how the Generagion MZ enjoys the music and culture of older generations - no wonder how she became an icon of MZers. In September this year PARKMOONCHI released a new EP named ParkRuRa with RuRu and RaRa. Combining R&B new jack swing and soul music the three musicians also known as PARKMOONCHI UNIVERSE show off their unique yet beautiful universe under their motto Pursuing joy and happiness together In this episode PARKMOONCHI performs m e s s a g e . . . and Move! from the album ParkRuRa her cover of Lee Ye-rin's Come On Baby Tonight as well as I Want To Hold Your Hand and The Story Of The Year with Onewoo. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this delightful and unpredicted artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - BAEK A YEON
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is talented vocalist BAEK A YEON! Known for her crystal clear voice BAEK A YEON made her big debut in 2012 after making it to the top three of the popular talent search show K-Pop Star in 2011. Then she dominated the top spots of various music charts and shows with the song Shouldn't Have... which she wrote at the end of a disappointing relationship. After that she released more songs about love oftentimes unrequited love including Looking For Love and so-so which has eventually become her own genre. In this episode BAEK A YEON performs Shouldn't Have... so-so Sweet Lies a Good Boy Jealousy and 0% the lead single off her latest album Observe. Tune in to I'm LIVE and fall in love with her crystalline voice once again!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - eldon
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter eldon! This artist became known to the public after taking part in the TV program Superstar K Season 7 where he made it to the top 5. Then in 2016 he officially made his debut as the vocalist of Martin Smith and once again surprised the public with his rhythmical vibes and songwriting skills. 2 years later in 2018 he started his career as a solo artist under his new stage name eldon. From his debut single Ghost! to Pink cheeks to Do monsters love too? he has already released an impressive set of albums which are full of his personal feelings and experiences. Also Pink cheeks was featured in the hit TV series My Roommate Is a Gumiho and widened his reach in the industry. In this episode eldon performs Pink cheeks Back to you and more to show off his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet eldon!

Slot ini turut diserikan dengan segmen Muzik Ekspress – Rima yang menampilkan siaran lagu-lagu Irama Melayu pilihan. Seterusnya, BBMU (Bingkisan Buat Mu) membawakan dedikasi khas kepada pendengar, di samping penyampaian ucapan yang diterima melalui Facebook dan WhatsApp. Slot ini juga memuatkan hebahan terkini sebelum diakhiri dengan penutup yang ringkas dan bermakna.

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.title: GLOBAL PERSPECTIVE : MALAYSIA'S REGIONAL DIPLOMATIC EFFORTS
programme.desc: Under the leadership of Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim, Malaysia has prioritized an \"ASEAN First\" foreign policy centered on deepening diplomatic ties, honest communication, and mutual respect with its neighbors to bolster economic and regional stability. This cooperative framework is materialized through major high-value cross-border projects with Singapore, such as the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JSSEZ) and the Rapid Transit System (RTS) Link, which aim to enhance digital economy integrations, secure sustainable skilled employment, and improve labor mobility. Furthermore, during its 2025 ASEAN Chairmanship focused on inclusivity and sustainability, Malaysia expanded the regional architecture by admitting Timor-Leste, charting the long-term \"ASEAN 2045\" strategic vision, and demonstrating its diplomatic efficacy by facilitating a swift 24-hour ceasefire between Cambodia and Thailand. Ultimately, these parallel security and geoeconomic strategies—such as releasing a historical communique regarding Palestine/Gaza and maintaining stable dialogue over the South China Sea—reinforce ASEAN centrality while driving Malaysia forward to attract major global investments and position Southeast Asia as a resilient, high-value global economic hub.

programme.title: Signal 1203
programme.desc: Signal 1203 – The Midnight Experience on REDfm\\\\n\\\\nGet ready for a brand-new late-night adventure with Signal 1203, your ultimate companion from 12am to 3am on REDfm for Variety! This isn’t just another radio show – it’s a full-on experience. Dive into fresh, youth-focused content, spine-chilling horror stories that will keep you on the edge of your seat, and trending topics that matter to you. We have Technology, Horror, chillout music, movie reviews, crime drama and so much more!\\\\n\\\\nAnd of course, what’s a night show without killer music? We’ve got the best tracks to keep your vibe alive through the early hours. Whether you’re up late studying, driving, or just chilling, Signal 1203 is your signal for something different.\\\\n\\\\nStay tuned. Stay awake. Stay connected. Only on REDfm – for variety.\\\\n\\\\n

programme.title: 早安 老时光
programme.desc: 每天 5点到6点，为您送上60-80 经典老歌，让你听出耳油！

programme.title: Morning Music 音乐早点
programme.desc: 《音乐早点》你最贴心的早间声音伴侣。我们不聊冗长的资讯，只精选最舒缓、最动听的旋律，配合清新的晨间絮语，为你卸去昨夜的疲惫，装满清晨的能量。无论你正行走在通勤的路上，还是在享用一份惬意的早餐，让《音乐早点》用惬意的乐音，陪你开启美好而有温度的一天。

programme.title: Midday Mix Part 1
programme.desc: Playing you the best hits from the past to current hits, along with news, interviews and interesting topics.

programme.title: MIDDAY MIX PART 2
programme.desc: Our variety program for the afternoon. 1pm - 4pm. Great music, fun DJs and total entertainment for 3 hours!!

programme.title: 音乐下午茶Teabreak
programme.desc: 星期一道星期六，下午4-5点，忙碌的午后，需要适时的暂停。《音乐下午茶》 是一档专为午后时光打造的治愈系音乐随笔节目。

programme.title: 下班开麦啦
programme.desc: 叮！下班铃声响起，属于你自己的时间正式开始。《下班开麦啦》是你在晚高峰通勤路上最懂你的“解压陪伴站”。告别繁琐的工作汇报和烦人的KPI，这里只有轻松搞笑的职场吐槽、热辣接地气的社会热议，以及最治愈的音乐与故事。无论你正挤在拥挤的地铁里，还是堵在回家的车流中，戴上耳机，和我们一起开麦畅聊，把一天的疲惫一扫而空！

programme.title: 听歌好时光
programme.desc: 忙碌的生活里，你有多久没有好好听完一首歌了？这里是《听歌好时光》，你的私享音乐会客厅。我们不设复杂的门槛，没有沉重的叙事，只挑选最惬意、最动听的旋律，为你揉碎日常的喧嚣。沏一杯清茶，或是斟一杯咖啡，在这个专属的空间里，让我们用好歌慢下来，静静享受属于你的好时光。

programme.title: Local Talent 珈有访客
programme.desc: 谁说好音乐都在远方？在我们脚下的这片土地，正涌动着最炙热的创作力量！《珈有访客》由主持人“珈”领衔，每期锁定宝藏本地艺人，为你抢先解锁他们的最新单曲、创作灵感与幕后八卦。从独立摇滚到温柔民谣，从流行打榜到本土原创，带你深度破圈，一起成为本地音乐的最强后援团！

programme.desc: A remote Jiangnan village plagued by mysterious deaths becomes known as the cursed ghost village Fengmen. Determined to uncover the truth, journalist Li Mu joins forces with officer Wan Feng to investigate the chilling incidents. As fear spreads among the villagers, the two risk their lives to expose the dark secrets behind Fengmen.

programme.title: Chapter 1 Mae Nak Reborn
programme.desc: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

programme.title: Hide & Seek
programme.desc: Thirteen years after an explosion in an abandoned building killed their friend Noo Aon, Tong and his group return to the site—now their university campus. When a girl who looks exactly like Noo Aon appears, a childhood game turns into a lethal ritual. One by one, the friends are hunted by a vengeful spirit determined to settle a long-overdue score.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.
